ayahs.1: Aap kah dijiye! ke main logon ke Parwardigaar ki panah mein aata hoon.
ayahs.4: Waswasa daalne wale peeche hat jaane wale ke shar se.
ayahs.5: Jo logon ke seenon mein waswasa daalta hai.
ayahs.6: (Khwah) woh jinn mein se ho ya insaan mein se.
